talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_stars.o: Look there, straight up. No, past those. Have you ever noticed that some stars never move with the rest?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_stars.a: Because they aren't hung on the same nail, I suppose. Here's a thing my mother used to say...
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_stars.c: Maybe I have. Maybe the cider's the only honest one in town.
My grandmother always said the giants by the old stones never came from the mountains. She said they came down.
She never said. She'd only point at her soup and laugh. But she did say this...
Tell that to the stones. Some of them still hum.
Your grandmother sounds like a wise woman.
She was. She looked up more than anyone I've known.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_rain.op: Taste that? The rain's sweet today. Some days it is. Like it fell from somewhere nobody's ever muddied.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_rain.a: Where would rain like that come from?
Somewhere clean. Somewhere kept. I'll tell you how my father put it...
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_rain.b: It tastes like rain to me.
Then you're lucky. It's easier not to wonder.
In a moment. I'm listening for something.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_pockets: That stone in your pack. I can hear it from here, humming like a kettle. Where did you... no. Don't say it out loud.
It's just a rock I found.
Of course it is. Then keep your rock out of sight of the priests.
You know what it is, don't you?
I know it's tired of the ground. Hush, now, walls have ears. But listen...
Because the ones who say it end up laughed out of town, or worse. I'll say it my way...
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_tower.o: You'll laugh. I'm building something by my house. Not a shed. Something tall. Very tall. I'm short of %3$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_tower.a: You will? Then it'll be taller by Sunday. Don't tell my family what it's for.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_tower.b: For seeing over things. Over everything. Let me put it a better way...
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.heavens_tower.c: You'll fall and break your neck.
Then I'll fall from higher than anyone in this town ever has.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.0: What has meadows with no ground under them, and rivers that fall and never land? When you know, you'll know why I look up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.1: There's a waterfall, far from any town, that has no top. Find it and follow the water the wrong way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.2: Whales don't belong in the sea. Ask anyone who's watched one swim through a cloud.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.3: Some stones are tired of the ground. Dig one up and let go of it, and see where it would rather be.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.4: The geese don't fly south in winter. Watch them. They go up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.5: If you climbed high enough, would the sky have a floor? I think it does. I think somebody sweeps it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.6: Gold grows on trees, somewhere. Not here. Higher.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.7: People say clouds are soft as wool. They say it like they've stood in one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.8: The giants by the old stones didn't walk here. Nobody gets that tired from walking.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.9: The wind always comes from somewhere. Nobody ever asks where it's been.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.10: On a still night you can hear something big breathing, far above the clouds. Most folk call it thunder.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.11: Some of the stars aren't stars. They're windows, and someone forgot to draw the curtains.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.12: The wizards who live on the floating rocks aren't hermits. They're halfway.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.13: Rain on a clear day. You've seen it. Did you never wonder whose it was?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.14: My father said a bird should never fly higher than it can fall. He never told me how high that was.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.15: What's above the clouds? More clouds, folk say. Folk say a lot of things.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.16: The highest mountain is only the first step. Nobody tells you what the second one stands on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.riddle.17: When the wind is just right you can smell flowers that don't grow anywhere here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.pocket.0: That stone in your bag hums. Wrap it in something and keep it away from the guards.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.pocket.1: You smell of cold cloud. Where have you been? No. Don't tell me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.pocket.2: Hold that gem up to the light some time and see which way it wants to go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.pocket.3: Where did you get that? Never mind. Keep it close and don't show it to the priest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.pocket.4: You've got dust on your boots that isn't from any road I know. Pale, like ground-up moonlight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.seeker.0: My tower's coming along. Don't look at it like that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.seeker.1: I need more scaffolding. I always need more scaffolding.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.seeker.2: Every rung I climb, the sky's no nearer. I'll keep at it anyway.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.seeker.3: My family thinks I'm building a lookout for raiders. Let them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.seeker.4: I fell off it again yesterday. Only from the third rung. Mostly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.seeker.5: One day I'll stand at the top and wave down at all of you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.seeker.6: Last time it was nearly high enough. Nearly. I could feel the cold.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.mutter.1: Higher. It has to be higher.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.mutter.5: So close you can almost hear the singing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.mutter.7: Which of you is the window?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.mutter.8: If the wind would only carry me...
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.topple.0: Not high enough. It's never high enough.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.topple.1: Down it comes. Up it goes again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.topple.2: The wind didn't want it. Fine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.topple.3: Too short by a mile. I'll start again, and taller.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.heavens.topple.4: Maybe it wasn't the height. Maybe it was the way.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.98: Not everyone in town looks up for the weather. A few of them know something they won't say plainly, and a few are trying to reach it.
